venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: Shotgun. Baugh downhill. Hitch when they sit. Odd front. Name the shell.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — Film Desk lock draft 2026-09-09. Charles tape wins. Fan rail stays empty until he says go.
headline: Florida kicked off. Coleman ended the first drive. They stretched the field, ran Baugh, and threw it now when the defense sat.
recap: Florida kicked off. FAU got the ball first. Third-and-10 at the Florida 35, DJ Coleman is already in the window. Drive over. From there they stretched the field, handed it to Jaden Baugh, and threw it now when the defense sat. Patrick Durkin from 53. FAU’s 18-yard punt starts the second Florida score. Florida never punts.

offense.body:
Buster Faulkner’s idea is a count. Spread the field so they cannot load the box and still cover. Shotgun. Give it to Jaden Baugh 13, downhill. When the corners sit, throw the hitch. When they cheat the run, go. That is how this offense attacks. It is not a trick show. It is not under-center. Pistol showed up as one look. The sneak is not the offense.

The line already looks more technically sound than a year ago. The run hits with real physicality. Faulkner can keep calling Baugh until they sit because the front is moving people.

First Gator run of the night is the proof. Shotgun. Baugh. Middle. Nine yards from their own 6. Same family after that. The only official snap that was not shotgun was the fourth-and-1 sneak — Aaron Philo 12, plus four. That is a conversion. It is not how they want to live.

Brown III 1 and Wilson 6 are why you spread them. The hitch only exists if those guys are out there making the defense choose.

defense.body:
Brad White’s idea is an odd front. Three down. JACK is Jayden Woods. STAR. Graham at WILL. If the broadcast counts four rushers, JACK is coming. Coverage mixes Cover 3, quarters, and man. Name the shell on that snap.

The proof is the first series. Florida kicked off. FAU first. Third-and-10 at the Florida 35. Coleman is already in the window because the front made the quarterback hold it. Drive over.

Areas of opportunity in the secondary were not a pile of missed tackles. They were not on the same call.

The Sledge keep: the design was sound. They lost the play. The call was right. The play was not finished.
